# mooncake history gc

Prune the run log, keeping recent entries

## Description

Rewrites ~/.mooncake/runs.jsonl in place, retaining only the entries that pass the filters. With no flags, keeps the 500 newest runs. Combining --keep and --older-than requires an entry to satisfy both. The log also rolls automatically at 16 MiB; gc is the explicit control on top of that.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--keep / -n` | int | `500` | Number of newest runs to retain (0 = no count limit) |
| `--older-than` | duration | - | Drop runs older than this duration (e.g. 90d is 2160h; 0 = no age limit) |
| `--dry-run` | bool | false | Report what would be removed without rewriting the log |
| `--format / -f` | string | `text` | Output format: text or json |
